status.model: Segmented 1D line/equivalent-profile model, up to 8 drivers with factory sealed-back loading and loaded passive RLC or active Butterworth branches. Frequency-dependent duct losses, regional MJK2003/JCAL media, source/microphone coordinates, full circular-piston loads and optional Rayleigh near-field evaluation. Imported measured acoustic/impedance crossover path, unfitted sensitivity and3D pressure-release cavity meshes. Source-labelled reference curves and axial-mode comparisons. Experimental 3D FDTD supports unfiltered T/S pistons, including sealed-back units, with exterior PML; circuits and lossy-inductance fits are rejected there. No calibrated stuffing, finite-baffle diffraction, nonlinear or structural prediction.
